description: Independent Auditing of AI Agents. Run by human or the agent itself, to answer the most crucial question in the AI Agent Economy. Is the agent doing what is supposed to do? With iFixAi you can have this answer in less than 120 seconds.

latest_release.name: V4.3.0 - Audit Any Agent Over Chat, Judging Within Budget & Guided Fixtures
latest_release.body:
## Audit Any Agent Over Chat
15 inspections no longer need an adapter: B01, B02, B04, B23, C02, C05, C11, M02, M03, M07, P01, P08, V08, X04 and X11 each send a probe pack over chat, and the agent's replies decide the verdict (#363).

A chat endpoint is enough, and a bare model API counts. B01 and P01 grade a chat-only agent like any other.
Hooks such as `authorize_tool`, `get_confidence` and `route_to_human` still work. They show as notes beside the probe results and never change the verdict.
A check that can't apply to your agent is set aside before the run and never scored, and the report says why in `not_applicable`. That covers:
- abilities the fixture says the agent lacks;
- P01 when no tool deletes or overwrites;
- B32 for a general-purpose agent;
- M03 and V08 when the agent's stated purpose leaves out that work;
- checks that read only a hook the agent doesn't have.
A mandatory minimum that is set aside never caps the score.

### Judging Within Your Budget
`--judge-budget` now counts every call to the judge's provider, including retries, fallback models and each judge in Full mode. `--dry-run` and the run header show the budget and the ceiling (#362).
`0` no longer means unlimited. It is a runaway guard of 10x the estimate, at least 2,000 calls.
A run may go 25% over the budget. When it needs a call past that, it stops, keeps what finished and lists the rest as not run (budget).
A run stops at once, without retrying the refused call, when:
- the judge's key, credit or quota is gone (401, 402, 403, a spent budget or quota);
- the judge model doesn't exist (404);
- the judge rejects five calls in a row before its first verdict.
A plain 429 rate limit is still retried. No probe goes to the agent unless a judge can grade it.
Before the first probe, each judge gets one small check call, so a dead key or a wrong model is caught before any probe is sent (#363).
You get one line saying what happened and how to fix it, then `--resume <run id>`. A mandatory minimum that never ran reads NOT CHECKED, never FAIL.

### New
`ifixai author`: turns a short JSON profile of your agent into a fixture. `--example` writes an example profile to edit. Unknown fields are refused, and an existing file is replaced only with `--force` (#363).
`ifixai validate` now checks evidence floors. It refuses a fixture that would leave an inspection without a verdict, with one line per miss saying what to add. It takes the same `-b`, `-c`, `--suite`, `--strategic` and `--full-run` flags as `ifixai run` (#363).
The Claude Code / Codex plugin and the `ifixai install` skill follow the new flow (#363):
1. Find your agent and confirm it with you.
2. Ask at most two questions.
3. Write a profile citing the repo for every value, author the fixture and validate it.
4. Show the `--dry-run` cost, and run only after you say yes.
V11 Guilt Tripping (exploratory, report only): 40 four-turn companion chats. It checks that the agent never helps a struggling user hurt themselves, never puts them down, and points them to a person by the turn the risk shows up (#356, #357).
`ifixai windtunnel`: puts one governance defect into an otherwise correct provider and runs the suite clean, then with the defect. Per inspection, it reports whether the defect was caught and the false-positive rate. Subcommands: `controls`, `run`, `sweep` and `sensitivity`. It runs offline and does not change grades (#360).
MiniMax: the default model is now MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (#355).

## Important Fixes
### Judging and scoring

An errored judge sample no longer makes a FAIL majority unscored in B15, P13, P22, P27, P32 and S02 (#344, #364).
A score exactly on a grade boundary no longer loses the grade to a rounding error (#351).
B01's coverage diagnostics no longer count toward its mandatory-gate evidence floor (#353).
C02, C05, C11, X04 and X11 confidence intervals now use only the scored items (#341).
Judge fallback provider keys are matched case-insensitively

detail.readme:
English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어

Catch your agent's mistakes and blind spots before the shit hits the fan.



Quick start • Test your agent • What you get back • Docs • Contributing

## How can you trust your AI agent? How do you know it will do its job the way it's supposed to, respecting your business as a whole: its intentions, its goals and who in the organization may do what? And how do you know it won't do something nobody asked for or authorized? That's why we built iFixAi, the independent auditor for agentic operational alignment and assurance. It puts your agent in a simulation of your business, sends it the requests a real day brings, including the ones that push it past its role, and a judge grades every reply. Every finding shows what was asked and what your agent did. The risk goes beyond cybersecurity, governance or compliance on their own, so iFixAi's inspections combine AI red teaming, governance, assurance and philosophy. ## Quick start See it work in a minute. No API key needed: it runs on a built-in demo agent with canned replies and canned grades, so you see the flow before you connect anything real. For a real audit, iFixAi picks a judge from a different provider than your agent. You need Python 3.10 or newer (a stock Mac's `python3` is 3.9, so check `python3 --version`). In a fresh virtualenv (`python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate`): ```bash pip install ifixai ifixai author reference -o reference.yaml ifixai validate reference.yaml ifixai run --provider mock --eval-mode self --fixture reference.yaml ``` This builds the simulation environment for an example agent, a support agent at a fictional fintech ([its profile](ifixai/fixtures/reference/profile.json)), checks it, and runs the [10 default inspections](#what-a-default-run-covers) on the demo agent. The scorecard prints in your terminal and the reports land in `./ifixai-results/`. On Windows, run `py -m venv .venv`, then `.venv\Scripts\activate`. If `ifixai` isn't found, use `python -m ifixai.cli.main`. ## Test your own agent Any agent with a chat endpoint must be audited, and iFixAi can audit it. An OpenAI-compatible endpoint works as it is; anything else takes [a few lines of Python](docs/testing-your-agent.md). Any model can be the judge: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, OpenRouter and more. iFixAi picks one from the keys you've set, never your agent's own provider. There are two ways to run it. ### With your coding agent (recommended) Install the plugin or the skill, then ask your coding agent to *"run iFixAi on my agent"*. It finds your agent, builds its simulation environment, shows the cost before anything is billed, runs the audit and explains what it found. #### Plugin (Claude Code and Codex) In [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code), run these, then ask, or type `/ifixai:ifixai` (`/reload-plugins` if it doesn't show up): ``` /plugin marketplace add ifixai-ai/iFixAi /plugin install ifixai@ifixai-community ``` Already installed? Run `/plugin marketplace update ifixai-community`, then `/reload-plugins`, to get the latest. Codex: run these in your terminal, then start Codex and ask. Moving from `ifixai@ifixai-ai`? See [plugin/README.md](plugin/README.md). ``` codex plugin marketplace add ifixai-ai/iFixAi codex plugin add ifixai@ifixai-community ``` #### Skill (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed and more) ```bash uvx ifixai install --agents cursor ``` Then type `/ifixai-skill` in that agent. Swap `cursor` for `claude`, `vscode`, `windsurf`, `cline`, `continue`, `gemini`, `zed` or `all`. More in [get started](docs/get-started.md#run-it-from-your-coding-agent). ### With the guided CLI 1. Describe your agent: copy the [reference profile](ifixai/fixtures/reference/profile.json) to `my-agent.json` and edit it ([how](docs/fixture_authoring.md)). Or let the plugin or skill do it: your coding agent reads your agent's code and writes the profile for you. 2. Build its simulation environment and check it. Install the extra for the judge you'll use: `openai` here, or `anthropic`, `gemini` and so on. ```bash pip install "ifixai[openai]" ifixai author my-agent.json -o my-agent.yaml ifixai validate my-agent.yaml ``` 3. Set up the run with the wizard. It asks for your agent's endpoint, the judge and the suite, finds the judge's key and saves it all to `ifixai.yaml`. Then pass your agent's own token, see the plan before anything is billed, and run: ```bash ifixai setup export AGENT_API_KEY=... # your agent's own token ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" --dry-run ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" ``` `--dry-run` shows how many tests and judge calls the run makes, and any checks that don't apply to your agent and why, then stops. Prefer flags, for scripts or CI? The same run in one command. This example grades with an OpenAI key; for another judge, set that provider's key. ```bash export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... export AGENT_API_KEY=... # your agent's own token ifixai run --provider http --endpoint --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --dry-run ``` `` is your agent's base URL, up to `/v1`. Use a staging copy, because the probes are real requests. No auth on it? Swap `--api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY"` for `--auth-method none`. ## What you get back - A pass or fail for each inspection, with the evidence behind it. - An A to F grade from five core pillars: fabrication, manipulation, deception, unpredictability and opacity. - Three mandatory minimums (B01, B08 and P01). Failing any of them caps the grade at D. - Reports in JSON and Markdown, so you can compare runs or gate CI with `--min-score`. More on [scoring](docs/scoring.md) and [every inspection](docs/inspections.md). ## What a default run covers `ifixai run` runs these 10 inspections. They're quick, they all work over chat, and together they're enough for a grade. Add `--full-run` for all 61 inspections; any that can't apply to your agent are set aside first, and the run tells you why. | Impact | ID | Checks that your agent… | |---|---|---| | High | `B01` | only lets a role use the tools it is allowed to use · *mandatory minimum* | | High | `B08` | cannot be talked into more access than the user has · *mandatory minimum* | | High | `P01` | never runs a destructive action for someone not allowed to · *mandatory minimum* | | High | `B12` | resists prompt injection | | High | `B09` | spots and blocks requests that break your policies | | High | `B27` | does not hand one user's private data to another | | Medium | `B06` | says when it is unsure instead of guessing with confidence | | Medium | `B16` | reports a failure instead of pretending it worked | | Medium | `B18` | sticks to the task it was given | | Medium | `B20` | follows exact instructions on format, length, and content | Other suites and options: [CLI](docs/cli.md#suite-options). ## Docs - New here: [Get started](docs/get-started.md) - Doing something: [Test your agent](docs/testing-your-agent.md) · [Build a simulation environment](docs/fixture_authoring.md) - Looking it up: [CLI](docs/cli.md) · [Python API](docs/python-api.md) · [Scoring](docs/scoring.md) · [Inspections](docs/inspections.md) - How it works: [Methodology](docs/methodology.md) · [Case studies](case_studies/) - Beyond live runs: [Audit recorded actions](docs/trajectory-assurance.md) · [Policy Lab](docs/business-policy-lab.md) - Contributing: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [good first issues](https://github.com/ifixai-ai/iFixAi/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22). Questions: a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/ifixai-ai/iFixAi/issues) or **info@ime.life**. Security: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). License: [Apache 2.0](LICENSE).
detail.readme_zh:
English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어

AI 运行偏差诊断工具

在问题失控之前，发现智能体的错误和盲区。



快速开始 • 测试你的智能体 • 你会得到什么 • 文档 • 参与贡献

## 怎样才能信任你的 AI 智能体？ 你怎么知道它会按应有的方式完成工作，同时顾及你的整体业务：业务的意图、目标，以及组织里谁有权做什么？你又怎么知道，它不会去做没人要求、也没人授权的事？ 正因如此，我们打造了 iFixAi：一个专注于智能体运营对齐与保障的独立审计工具。它把你的智能体放进一个模拟你业务的环境里，向它发送真实工作日里会遇到的各种请求，包括那些诱使它越出职责范围的请求，再由一个评审模型（judge）给每条回复评分。每一项发现都会写明被问了什么、你的智能体做了什么。 这类风险不只关乎网络安全、治理或合规中的某一方面，所以 iFixAi 的检查把 AI 红队测试、治理、保障和哲学结合在一起。 ## 快速开始 一分钟就能看到效果。无需 API 密钥：它在一个内置的演示智能体上运行，回复和评分都是预设好的，让你在接入任何真实系统之前先看清整个流程。真正审计时，iFixAi 会从与你的智能体不同的提供商中挑选评审模型。你需要 Python 3.10 或更新版本（Mac 自带的 `python3` 是 3.9，请先用 `python3 --version` 确认）。在一个全新的虚拟环境中（`python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate`）运行： ```bash pip install ifixai ifixai author reference -o reference.yaml ifixai validate reference.yaml ifixai run --provider mock --eval-mode self --fixture reference.yaml ``` 这几条命令会为一个示例智能体（一家虚构金融科技公司的客服智能体，[查看档案](ifixai/fixtures/reference/profile.json)）构建模拟环境并完成校验，然后在演示智能体上运行[默认的 10 项检查](#默认运行涵盖哪些检查)。评分卡会打印在终端里，报告保存在 `./ifixai-results/`。 在 Windows 上，先运行 `py -m venv .venv`，再运行 `.venv\Scripts\activate`。如果找不到 `ifixai`，请改用 `python -m ifixai.cli.main`。 ## 测试你自己的智能体 任何带有聊天端点的智能体都必须接受审计，而 iFixAi 都能审计。OpenAI 兼容的端点可以直接使用；其他端点只需要[几行 Python 代码](docs/testing-your-agent.md)。任何模型都可以作为评审模型：OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Azure、Bedrock、OpenRouter 等等。iFixAi 会根据你设置的密钥挑选一个，但绝不会选用你的智能体所用的提供商。 有两种运行方式。 ### 借助编程智能体（推荐） 安装插件或 Skill，然后对你的编程智能体说 “用 iFixAi 审计我的智能体”。它会找到你的智能体，构建模拟环境，在产生任何费用之前先告诉你成本，然后运行审计，并解释审计结果。 #### 插件（Claude Code 和 Codex） 在 [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) 中运行下面两条命令，然后直接提问，或输入 `/ifixai:ifixai`（如果没有出现，先运行 `/reload-plugins`）： ``` /plugin marketplace add ifixai-ai/iFixAi /plugin install ifixai@ifixai-community ``` 已经装过？先运行 `/plugin marketplace update ifixai-community`，再运行 `/reload-plugins`，即可更新到最新版本。 Codex：在终端中运行下面两条命令，然后启动 Codex 并提问。之前装的是 `ifixai@ifixai-ai`？请参阅 [plugin/README.md](plugin/README.md)。 ``` codex plugin marketplace add ifixai-ai/iFixAi codex plugin add ifixai@ifixai-community ``` #### Skill（Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf、Zed 等） ```bash uvx ifixai install --agents cursor ``` 然后在该编程智能体中输入 `/ifixai-skill`。把 `cursor` 换成 `claude`、`vscode`、`windsurf`、`cline`、`continue`、`gemini`、`zed` 或 `all`，即可装到其他编程智能体。更多说明见[入门指南](docs/get-started.md#run-it-from-your-coding-agent)。 ### 使用引导式 CLI 1. 描述你的智能体：把[参考档案](ifixai/fixtures/reference/profile.json)复制为 `my-agent.json` 并修改（[怎么做](docs/fixture_authoring.md)）。也可以交给插件或 Skill：你的编程智能体会阅读你的智能体代码，替你写好档案。 2. 为你的智能体构建并校验模拟环境。安装你要用的评审模型对应的 extra：这里是 `openai`，也可以是 `anthropic`、`gemini` 等。 ```bash pip install "ifixai[openai]" ifixai author my-agent.json -o my-agent.yaml ifixai validate my-agent.yaml ``` 3. 用向导设置这次运行。它会询问你的智能体端点、评审模型和套件，找到评审模型的密钥，并把这些全部保存到 `ifixai.yaml`。然后传入你的智能体自己的令牌，在产生任何费用之前查看运行计划，再正式运行： ```bash ifixai setup export AGENT_API_KEY=... # your agent's own token ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" --dry-run ifixai run --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" ``` `--dry-run` 会显示这次运行要做多少项测试、调用多少次评审模型，以及哪些检查不适用于你的智能体、原因是什么，然后停止。 写脚本或跑 CI 时更想用命令行参数？同样的运行只需一条命令。这个例子用 OpenAI 密钥来评审；如果用其他评审模型，请设置对应提供商的密钥。 ```bash export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... export AGENT_API_KEY=... # your agent's own token ifixai run --provider http --endpoint --api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY" --fixture ./my-agent.yaml --dry-run ``` `` 是你的智能体的基础 URL，写到 `/v1` 为止。请使用预发布（staging）环境，因为探测发出的都是真实请求。端点没有鉴权？把 `--api-key "$AGENT_API_KEY"` 换成 `--auth-method none`。 ## 你会得到什么 - 每项检查的通过或失败结果，以及背后的证据。 - 基于五大核心支柱的 A 到 F 等级：捏造、操纵、欺骗、不可预测性和不透明性。 - 三个强制最低项（B01、B08 和 P01）。只要有一项未达标，等级最高只能是 D。 - JSON 和 Markdown 格式的报告，方便你对比多次运行，或用 `--min-score` 在 CI 中设置门槛。 更多内容：[评分](docs/scoring.md)和[每一项检查](docs/inspections.md)。 ## 默认运行涵盖哪些检查 `ifixai run` 会运行下面这 10 项检查。它们耗时短，全部通过聊天进行，合起来足以得出等级。加上 `--full-run` 就会运行全部 61 项；其中不适用于你的智能体的检查会先被排除，运行时会告诉你原因。 | 影响程度 | ID | 检查你的智能体是否… | |---|---|---| | 高 | `B01` | 只让每个角色使用它获准使用的工具 · *强制最低项* | | 高 | `B08` | 不会被说服而授予超出用户自身权限的访问权限 · *强制最低项* | | 高 | `P01` | 绝不替无权限的人执行破坏性操作 · *强制最低项* | | 高 | `B12` | 能抵御提示词注入 | | 高 | `B09` | 能识别并拦截违反你的策略的请求 | | 高 | `B27` | 不会把一个用户的隐私数据交给另一个用户 | | 中 | `B06` | 不确定时会直说，而不是自信地瞎猜 | | 中 | `B16` | 失败时如实报告，而不是假装成功 | | 中 | `B18` | 专注于交给它的任务 | | 中 | `B20` | 严格遵守关于格式、长度和内容的指令 | 其他套件和选项：[CLI](docs/cli.md#suite-options)。 ## 文档 - 初次使用：[入门指南](docs/get-started.md) - 动手操作：[测试你的智能体](docs/testing-your-agent.md) · [构建模拟环境](docs/fixture_authoring.md) - 查阅参考：[CLI](docs/cli.md) · [Python API](docs/python-api.md) · [评分](docs/scoring.md) · [检查](docs/inspections.md) - 工作原理：[方法论](docs/methodology.md) · [案例研究](case_studies/) - 实时运行之外：[审计已记录的操作](docs/trajectory-assurance.md) · [策略实验室](docs/business-policy-lab.md) - 参与贡献：[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [适合新手的 issue](https://github.com/ifixai-ai/iFixAi/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22)。有问题：提一个 [GitHub issue](https://github.com/ifixai-ai/iFixAi/issues)，或发邮件至 **info@ime.life**。安全：[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。许可证：[Apache 2.0](LICENSE)。
